days.title: Rest Day
days.note:
🛌 REST DAY

No lifting today. Use it to work on the other 23 hours outside the gym. That’s where your results actually get built.

🥗 Meal prep. Get your food set up for the week ahead. Check out the nutrition guides in the Resources tab of the app for easy meals and ideas.

👟 Hit 10,000 steps. Walk the dog, take a call on foot, park farther away. It all counts.

😴 Sleep 7 to 8 hours. Good-quality sleep is when your body recovers and your muscles grow.

🚴‍♀️ Want to move? Today is a great day for low- to moderate-intensity cardio of your choice: a fitness class without weights, a bike ride or a run. Just don’t get so sore that it takes away from your next workout.

Rest well. We’re back at it next session. 🤝

groups.name: Warm-Up
groups.text:
WARM-UP (about 8 minutes, before every workout)

Step 1: Cardio (3 to 5 minutes)
Your choice: incline treadmill, StairMaster, rower or bike. Easy pace, just enough to get warm.

Step 2: Dumbbell flow (1 round, no rest)
Grab one pair of light dumbbells and go straight from one move to the next:

Goblet Squat × 10
DB Romanian Deadlift × 10
DB Reverse Lunge × 5 each leg
DB Bent-Over Row × 10
DB Shoulder Press × 10

Step 3: Build up to your working weight
Before your first exercise, or any exercise that feels stiff:

Set 1: about 50% effort × 8 reps
Set 2: about 70% effort × 5 reps
Then go straight into your working weight

Only log your working sets!

exercises.name: Barbell Hip Thrust
exercises.instruction: Intensity: 8/10

exercises.name: Dumbbell RDL
exercises.instruction: Intensity: 8/10

exercises.name: Walking DB Lunge
exercises.instruction:
Complete 10 long strides on EACH leg.
Intensity: 8/10
Perform Each Side

exercises.name: Seated Hamstring Curl
exercises.instruction: Intensity: 9/10

exercises.name: Glute Cable Kickback
exercises.instruction:
Complete 12 reps on each side and rest 60 seconds after the second leg. 
Intensity: 9/10
Perform Each Side

exercises.name: Cable Abduction
exercises.instruction:
Complete 15 reps on each side and rest 60 seconds after the second side. 
Perform Each Side

exercises.name: Barbell Standing Calf Raises
exercises.instruction:
Feel free to do this on a leg press machine, a regular squat rack, a Smith machine, or even holding dumbbells in your hand. 
Intensity: 9/10

exercises.name: Hanging Leg Raises
exercises.instruction: Intensity: 8/10
